title: Chen Chi Mei

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL · POLICE FORCE · DETECTIVE BRANCH）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 167
Date 15 / 3 / 16
14th March 1916

Sir,
The Central Government has instructed General Yang
to send maps to Peking showing the location of the
troops in the Shanghai district and the number of men
at each place.

A code telegram was received at the Arsenal yesterday
from the Central Government requesting the immediate
despatch of arms and ammunition to Nanking. The Director
of the Arsenal wired a reply regretting his inability
to comply with the order.

X It is reported that Chen Chi Mei 陈其美 and Nyeu
Tik Sung 程铁生, head of the local branch of the
Anti-Yuan army, are arranging to start a rising here
X on a date between 18th and 24th instant.

Eleven robbers, including three handed over by the
French Police, were shot at the Arsenal yesterday after-
noon.

Your obedient servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

( )
Seen by C I P
Intelligence 15 March 16
page_data.zh:
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局 · 警务处 · 侦探股）
警务处，
（侦探股）

刑事侦缉处
情报登记
第 167 号
日期 1916 年 3 月 15 日
1916 年 3 月 14 日

先生：

中央政府已指令杨将军向北京发送地图，标明上海地区部队的驻地以及各地的人数。

兵工厂昨日收到中央政府发来的密电，要求立即向南京运送军火。兵工厂厂长回电表示抱歉，称无法执行该命令。

X 据报，陈其美与反袁军本地分支负责人程铁生 (Nyeu Tik Sung) 正策划于本月 18 日至 24 日之间在此地发动起义 X。

昨日下午，包括由法国巡捕房移交的三人在内的十一名劫匪在兵工厂被枪决。

您忠实的仆人，

[签名]

首席探长。

警务处总监。

( )
刑事侦缉处长阅
情报科 1916 年 3 月 15 日
